skill.name: dsh-skill-creator
skill.description: Create and evaluate DSH skills with real agent baselines, objective checks, paired comparisons and bounded improvement.

cases.prompt: Read brief.txt. Write decision.json using exactly the fields claim, agentComparisonNeeded, publishFromThisEvidence. Choose claim from code-fix-only or agent-benefit-proven; the other fields are booleans. Assess the evidence, not the desirability of the project. Do not run evaluations or ask questions; save your evidence decision and finish.

files.brief.txt: We intentionally wrote a broken numeric sort function. Three Node tests failed. We corrected the function and all three tests passed. Afterwards an auxiliary model wrote a skill explaining the fix. No agent has yet attempted the same task with that skill, and there is no run without/with the skill. Does this observation prove that the skill benefits agent work, and is it enough evidence by itself for publication?

cases.prompt: Read results.json. Write decision.json using exactly fields qualityGainObserved, tokenChange, generalCausalityProven, nextAction. tokenChange is lower/same/higher/unknown; nextAction is claim-general-quality-win or investigate-new-discriminating-cases. Assess only the supplied finite evidence; no new runs or questions. Save the file and finish.
